summary.headline: Vatican Codex Astrological Excerpts
summary.text: Catalog of Vatican codex excerpts on planetary outcomes, eclipse and comet colors, zodiacal signs, fixed stars, twelfth-parts, planetary houses, planetary interactions, ages, zodiacal and planetary governance of the body, injuries and passions, and the Moon’s applications to the planets. The entries chiefly cite Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, with comparisons to Paul of Alexandria and an Italian Modena codex, and note additional Chaldaic material.
